add_rc_deps(sndvol32.rc ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/resources/sndvol32.ico)

# sndvol32.exe is all Rust (sndvol32-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/sndvol32-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# advanced.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/sndvol32-rust/src/sndvol32/advanced.rs)
# dialog.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/sndvol32-rust/src/sndvol32/dialog.rs)
# misc.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/sndvol32-rust/src/sndvol32/misc.rs)
# mixer.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/sndvol32-rust/src/sndvol32/mixer.rs)
# sndvol32.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/sndvol32-rust/src/sndvol32/sndvol32.rs)
# tray.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/sndvol32-rust/src/sndvol32/tray.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(sndvol32_shims OBJECT rust_varargs_shim.c)
target_compile_definitions(sndvol32_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(sndvol32_res OBJECT sndvol32.rc)
target_compile_definitions(sndvol32_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(sndvol32_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set(SNDVOL32_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/crt/CMakeFiles/oldnames.dir/oldnames.a)
add_cargo_module(sndvol32 sndvol32-cargo sndvol32.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE sndvol32-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS sndvol32_shims sndvol32_res ${SNDVOL32_REUSED})
